reference_sql:
WITH weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT week_start FROM calendar WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'),
revenue AS (SELECT o.store_id, c.week_start, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN calendar c ON c.cal_date = CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) GROUP BY o.store_id, c.week_start)
SELECT s.store_code, w.week_start, COALESCE(r.net_revenue_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM stores s
CROSS JOIN weeks w
LEFT JOIN revenue r ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND r.week_start = w.week_start
WHERE s.country_code = 'BE'

solver.query:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT week_start
  FROM calendar
  WHERE week_start >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND week_start <= DATE '2025-03-31'
), sales_lines AS (
  SELECT o.store_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS d,
         l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur AS revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, w.week_start, COALESCE(SUM(sl.revenue), 0) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM stores s
CROSS JOIN weeks w
LEFT JOIN sales_lines sl ON sl.store_id = s.store_id AND sl.d >= w.week_start AND sl.d <= w.week_start + 6
WHERE s.country_code = 'BE'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code, w.week_start
